A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same KDF/KDN research despite the title change. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables and appendices support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V6 reports original simulation, OpenML-CC18 and vision benchmark results in Section 6, Figures 1–2, Table 1 and the appendices.

after.justification: V7 reports original simulations and benchmark evaluations, including the added controlled image-shift experiments in Section 5.2 and Figure 3.

M1.justification: The KDF/KDN Gaussian fitting, similarity weights, nearest-kernel selection and biased Bayesian inference remain unchanged. The coordinatewise variance formula is equivalent to v6's diagonal covariance formulation. The vision backbone changes concern experimental configurations.

E1.justification: V7 adds controlled circle/rectangle image classification and OOD scenarios involving color intensity, image mixtures and ellipse-axis variation. These substantially extend the tested input conditions beyond v6's existing simulations and vision benchmarks, whose coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds ODIN and outlier exposure (OE) to the vision comparisons, retaining the parent model, Isotonic, Sigmoid and ACET. ODIN and OE were already cited in v6 but were absent from its reported comparisons.

E3.justification: The vision benchmark changes from ResNet-20 to a contrastively pretrained ResNet-50 encoder with 256-dimensional features and 200/10-node dense layers. V7 also specifies a new CNN experiment using 4,000 shape images. Figure 1's reported Trunk dimensionality sweep ends around 100 instead of 1,000.

E4.justification: New Figure 3 tests confidence responses to color shifts, circle/rectangle mixtures and geometric deformation against the parent CNN. The Trunk dimensionality-sensitivity results are also revised; the existing Euclidean-versus-geodesic comparison remains.

E5.justification: Table 1 introduces ± uncertainty values without specifying their estimation procedure or run count. Figure 2 retains only the baseline-worse directional Wilcoxon p-values instead of reporting both directions. The 45 simulation repetitions and percentile-band reporting remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Vision results are replaced: KDN's CIFAR-10 accuracy changes from 83.60 to 76.84±0.01, and SVHN AUROC from 0.86 to 1.00±0.00. Different encoders prevent direct performance comparison. Trunk calibration curves change, and Figure 3 adds findings of reduced KDN confidence under image shifts.

T1.justification: V7 removes the density-consistency Theorem 1, Corollaries 3–5 and their supporting appendix arguments, including Lemmas 7–8. The OOD-limit theorem and distance-metric result survive as Propositions 4 and 2. The ID-region definition also changes from the joint distribution to the input marginal.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contributions and discussion withdraw the advertised density-consistency and joint asymptotic-convergence guarantees. The desiderata instead emphasize empirical accuracy and ID/OOD calibration, substantially narrowing the theoretical contribution while retaining the joint-calibration objective.

C2.justification: V6 explicitly identifies near-OOD performance as needing further work and discusses known outliers and alternative kernels. V7 removes these qualifications, describes the vision results as good joint calibration, and interprets the new shift experiments as tuning to training concepts and suppressing deviations.

D1.justification: V7 adds CNN and encoder specifications, an O(mn²) complexity statement and a promise to release code upon acceptance. However, Tables 2–3 omit v6's explicit bias-parameter setting. The other listed hyperparameters, pseudocode and hardware/software information are retained.

R1.justification: V7 adds Khosla et al.'s supervised contrastive learning reference and removes Fort, Athey and Hornik references associated with deleted discussion and proofs. Section 2 replaces the convergence contribution with positioning around applicability to both tabular and vision problems.

P1.justification: V7 changes the title and author line, edits introductory prose, rewrites the desiderata and discussion, and groups experiments into tabular and vision subsections. Much of the retained method exposition and appendix prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redesigned with separate simulation blocks; Figure 2 changes sizing and statistical annotations; Figure 3 is added. Table 1 gains comparator columns, separate metric rows, direction arrows and bolding. Appendix plots are compacted and reformatted, while the posterior heatmap is retained as renumbered Figure 4.

improvement.justification: The controlled vision tests and ODIN/OE comparisons strengthen empirical scrutiny. However, near-OOD qualifications and the explicit bias setting disappear, while the new uncertainty values lack a stated estimation procedure. With the consistency theory also withdrawn, the empirical gains and losses in qualification and reproducibility do not establish a reliable net quality direction.
